stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid affair scandal; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after 33 years at the helm following revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including an alleged relationship with a woman under investigation for ties to Chinese intelligence and potential export-control circumvention involving Super Micro servers. NVDA shares fell about 13-14% over the following days, erasing as much as $600 billion in market cap, while analyst Dan Ives cut his price target from $300 to $225. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO, and Huang is expected to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving.

stories.headline: AMD, Broadcom jump as rivals benefit from Nvidia leadership crisis
stories.summary: AMD shares rose roughly 5-7% and Broadcom gained more than 5% as investors rotated into Nvidia's chip rivals following Jensen Huang's resignation. The S&P 500 initially dropped nearly 1% on the news but recovered about $1 trillion in value within 90 minutes as competitor strength offset Nvidia's slide. Retail investors bought an estimated $111 million of NVDA shares in the first 30 minutes of trading, signaling some dip-buying confidence.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO to test Wall Street's AI appetite amid cooling enthusiasm
stories.summary: Anthropic is targeting a $1.3-$1.4 trillion valuation for its IPO, set to begin trading November 19, down from earlier hopes of $1.5-$2 trillion as investor enthusiasm for AI cools. Underwriters including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley stand to collect roughly $395 million in combined fees, but the offering faces a tougher backdrop than SpaceX's June listing, with rising Treasury yields, a Microsoft Outlook outage, and the Nvidia leadership upheaval all weighing on sentiment.

stories.headline: Treasury yields climb above 5% as oil rises on Trump's hardened Iran stance
stories.summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield climbed above 5% this week, adding to inflation concerns alongside rising oil prices tied to President Trump's tougher rhetoric on Iran. The combination of higher yields and energy costs compounded pressure on equities already rattled by the Nvidia leadership crisis, contributing to broader market volatility.

stories.headline: Micron rebounds nearly 12% as Bernstein, KeyBanc defend DRAM shortage thesis
stories.summary: Micron shares rebounded 11.9% after a sharp early-November drop tied to a broader memory-stock selloff. Bernstein analyst Mark Li reiterated a Buy rating with a $1,300 price target, arguing the DRAM shortage is more severe and longer-lasting than expected, while KeyBanc kept an Overweight rating and $1,750 target citing fourth-quarter DRAM prices up 15-20%. Micron posted fiscal Q4 revenue of $54.23 billion, up sharply from $11.32 billion a year earlier, with guidance of about $61.5 billion next quarter.

stories.headline: Memory chip stocks slide on Nvidia leadership shakeup spillover
stories.summary: Memory manufacturers including SanDisk, Micron, and SK Hynix saw volatile trading as the Nvidia leadership crisis rippled through the broader semiconductor sector. The moves reflected investor concern about contagion risk to AI-adjacent supply chains even though the memory makers' fundamentals were largely unaffected by Nvidia's internal turmoil.

stories.headline: SpaceX IPO execs say space industry still in 'earliest innings' as orbital data centers emerge
stories.summary: Following SpaceX's IPO earlier this year, industry executives say the space sector remains in its early stages of commercialization, pointing to emerging opportunities such as orbital data centers. The comments come as investors weigh how much further capital could flow into space infrastructure plays beyond the initial public offering wave.

stories.headline: Tesla opens Cybercab pre-orders for select customers
stories.summary: Tesla began taking pre-orders for its autonomous Cybercab, making the robotaxi-style vehicle available on a limited basis to select customers. The move marks an early commercialization step for Tesla's self-driving ambitions as the company works to scale production and regulatory approval.
